propositions: A check producing an absence-based result (pass or fail) cannot be distinguished from the check never running if the producer's liveness is not verified beforehand
Fail-open oracles include absence assertions over subprocess/file/network output, greps over command output, and silent lookup misses without liveness checks
The fail-open pattern must be added to the existing tests criterion for test-oracle population and error-handling criterion for shipped-code population
Calibration requires 9 pre-fix cases to fire with quoted claims naming the seeded fail-open defect and 9 post-fix cases to remain silent
Documentation must be added to the code-review author guide with at least two worked examples demonstrating the fail-open antipattern
Eval specs must validate strict-clean offline and FP posture must be recorded for both host criteria already at blocking thresholds
